title: A Semester for the Locker
author: Oscar Fairweather
blurb: Edmund Nakamura, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must expose what the school board buried before graduation.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
